meta.title: Skill manager
meta.description: Adds a Skills row to the sidebar's global entry list. Selecting it opens a manager page in the main column that lists SKILL.md skills from the project and user roots. Install by choosing files through the system file picker, uploading a whole skill folder, browsing the Host filesystem in-app (/sdcard and elsewhere), or typing a path; user skills can be deleted with a two-step confirmation. Only ~/.dsh/skills is writable and project skills are read-only. New skills are picked up by the filesystem provider on the next session or tool step.
